summary: Primary City of Syracuse Surveillance Technology Working Group presentation from January 27, 2026 recording the proposed Axon ALPR agreement terms: 26 readers; purchase, installation, and maintenance; a March 1, 2026 effective date; 60 months; the first 12 months free; a not-to-exceed amount of $422,636.28; and waiver of the RFP process.
